next_strategy.name: SPY/QQQ 15-min ORB
next_strategy.setup: Mark 9:30-9:45 high/low. Long calls: price breaks ORB high AND above VWAP. Long puts: price breaks ORB low AND below VWAP. If break and VWAP disagree — skip. Stop at opposite ORB level. Volume confirms.
next_strategy.notes: Account ~$215. SPY 0DTE ATM contracts run $1-3 each. True 0DTE available daily on both. Need $300+ for 0DTE — consider 1-2 DTE until account rebuilds.

scan_criteria.price_vs_vwap: above VWAP for longs, below VWAP for shorts
scan_criteria.breakout_level: breaking 9:30-9:45 ORB high (calls) or ORB low (puts)
scan_criteria.price_action: higher highs + higher lows on 5-min chart

entry_rules.contracts: size for ~$100-150 risk max given account size
entry_rules.expiration: 1-2 DTE minimum until account >$300; then 0DTE ok
entry_rules.earnings_check: MUST verify no earnings before expiration
entry_rules.vwap_rule: MUST agree with ORB direction — if they disagree, skip the trade
entry_rules.gap_rule: Never buy at market open on gap-up; wait for VWAP pullback and bounce confirmation

pending_morning.plan: 9:30-9:45: mark ORB high/low, note VWAP level. 9:45+: if price breaks ORB high AND is above VWAP → buy calls. If price breaks ORB low AND is below VWAP → buy puts. Target 80-100% gain, stop at 50% loss.

trade_log.notes: ORB + VWAP breakout entry at 10am. SPY ran to $2.47 (+35%) then faded back below entry. Cut manually when SPY broke back through VWAP. Small loss, good discipline.
Exited before earnings (IONQ reported 8/5 after close). Momentum trade, not earnings play.
Entered at market open on +24% gap — chased the gap. Stock faded immediately. Lesson: never buy at open on gap-up; wait for VWAP pullback and bounce. IV was 179-215% (way too high).
SOFI reversed from -1.6% to +1% at open 8/6, IV ~50%, 8 days runway. Stock dumped overnight 8/7. Stop at $0.165 hit at $0.155, closed at $0.15.

lessons: Never buy at market open on a gap-up — wait for VWAP pullback and bounce
IV >100% means premium is sky-high; prefer IV <80%
ORB + VWAP filter removes most bad entries
